01 / WHERE DISCIPLINE BEGAN

Before the code,
there was the field.

At 14, soccer became more than a game for me. I played for E.C. Juventude’s youth academy in Brazil from 2010 until 2019, training five to six times a week and treating the sport as a profession.

That routine taught me discipline, commitment, and hard work. It also shaped my understanding of leadership: showing up consistently and doing my part for the team.

14Years old when the routine began
5–6Training sessions each week

02 / MADONNA UNIVERSITY · USA

Learning to lead.
On and off the field.

Three years.Team captain through all of them.

For all three of my years at Madonna University in the United States, I was the soccer team captain. Alongside a Computer Science major and a full-time athletic schedule, I worked on campus as a Resident Assistant.

Balancing those responsibilities meant learning to manage my time, stay accountable, and show up for the people who relied on me—in class, on the field, and in the residence halls.

  • Computer Science major
  • Full-time student-athlete
  • Soccer team captain
  • Resident Assistant
